caption: The drawing depicts a beaded bag or pouch, centrally positioned against a plain, light beige background. The main body of the bag is decorated with floral patterns, prominently featuring large red and pink roses with yellow and white highlights, surrounded by green leaves and stems. Blue and red smaller flowers are interspersed among the larger roses. The top edge of the bag is bordered by a horizontal band of densely packed small purple flowers against a maroon background. The bottom portion of the bag tapers slightly and contains additional decorative elements, including a blue and white flower and various green foliage set against a maroon background. The entire composition is rendered in a style that imitates the appearance of beadwork, with each color area broken up into small dots or segments, emphasizing the texture and design of traditional beaded embroidery.
title: Beaded Bag
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
